Context
Projects include a Context section where you add the reference
material Claude should be able to consult during any session. Context
can be a local folder linked from your computer or a URL. Linking a
local folder is the most common approach: if a client's brand guide, style
sheet, and specification documents all live in a folder on your desktop,
link that folder once and Claude can read from it in every subsequent
session. Because you are linking the live folder rather than uploading a
snapshot, changes to those files are picked up automatically.

Chapter Summary and Key Takeaways
Agentic AI is powerful because it acts. That power comes with real
risk. The capability that lets Claude Code make you more productive can
cause real damage if misused or compromised.

The risks are manageable. Prompt injection is real, but you can
protect yourself by being skeptical of unexpected actions. MCP servers
are attack vectors, but install only from trusted sources and review
permissions carefully. Approval fatigue is a human problem, and
discipline is the cure. File safety is a matter of backups and permissions.

Competency in knowledge work now increasingly means thinking
clearly about what to delegate, to whom, under what conditions, and with
what safeguards. This is harder than simply doing the work yourself, at
least initially. It requires clear articulation of what you want, verification
that what comes back is correct, understanding of what could go wrong,
and judgment about acceptable risk. But it is also a multiplier. A person
who masters this skill accomplishes roughly ten times as much in the
same number of hours.

The reader has now spent the preceding chapters developing exactly
that skill. You have learned how to direct Claude Code and Cowork, how
to grant and revoke permissions, how to verify outputs, and how to
maintain control over systems that act on your behalf. The investment
applies to any agentic system you encounter in the future—newer
versions of Claude, tools from other AI companies, agents built on other
architectures. The principles do not change.
